title: Senator Coons Urges Congress to Act on AI Risks
description:
Senator Chris Coons is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Congress needs enforceable guardrails for rapidly advancing AI, warning that lawmakers are struggling to keep pace while competition with China makes a full development pause impractical. Coons also tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that managing the technology’s risks will ultimately require cooperation among industry, Congress and governments around the world.
